newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia stock volume doubles, Unibanka slips.
newsitem.headline: Latvia stock volume doubles, Unibanka slips.

text.p: Latvian share trade doubled on Tuesday and Unibanka slipped on unexpected news of the cancellation of a merger with Zemes Bank, dealers said.
Total turnover jumped to 208,000 lats versus 114,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's index lost 0.7 percent to close at 228.33.
Market leader Unibanka slipped four santimes to 4.88 lats on trade of 25,700 lats as news of the merger cancellation reached the market.
"It happened more because it came so unexpectedly, because in itself Unibanka is stable enough," one dealer said.
Unibanka and Zemes said they were cancelling the merger as they had decided that the synergies from the deal were not as great as expected.
Secondary list stocks Daugavpils Chain and Kaija fish cannery led today's trade with volumes of 61,000 and 55,800 lats respectively.
Daugavpils jumped ten santimes to 2.85 lats and Kaija advanced two santimes to 2.35 lats after it announced it made a profit in 1996.
Rigas Raugs yeast factory was also actively traded as it remained stable on volume of 14,700 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre fell 13 santimes to 1.87 lats on a comparatively small volume of 4,800 lats.

Elsewhere on the official list Staburadze confectionery closed one santiime up at 2.71 lats as it traded 5,800 lats of shares and Riga Transport Fleet also added two santimes to 1.72 lats. It had volume of 4,400 lats.
